rows.source_ko: Chapter 1 General Provisions
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies ” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies within the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies ” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies within the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto.

rows.source_ko: Chapter 2 Ministry of SMEs and Startups
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Ministry of SMEs and Startups

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② One Public Relations Officer and one Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed under the Spokesperson; the Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer, and the Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended Jan. 21, 2020; Feb. 28, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>
rows.text_en: ② One Public Relations Officer and one Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed under the Spokesperson; the Public Relations Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer, and the Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended Jan. 21, 2020; Feb. 28, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters. <Amended Dec. 20, 2022>
rows.text_en: ③ The Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters. <Amended Dec. 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. Establishment, coordination, consultation, and support of public relations plans for major policies
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, consultation, and support of public relations plans for major policies

rows.source_ko: 2. Management of PR performance regarding major policies and evaluation of PR activities
rows.text_en: 2. Management of PR performance regarding major policies and evaluation of PR activities

rows.source_ko: 3. Establishment, implementation, and overall management and coordination of media coverage plans
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment, implementation, and overall management and coordination of media coverage plans

rows.source_ko: 4. Matters concerning media cooperation, including newspapers, broadcasting, and online media
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning media cooperation, including newspapers, broadcasting, and online media

rows.source_ko: 5. Planning and management of external announcements of major policies through media outlets, such as briefings and e-briefings.
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and management of external announcements of major policies through media outlets, such as briefings and e-briefings.

rows.source_ko: 6. Matters concerning promotion using media, such as press advertising and program production
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning promotion using media, such as press advertising and program production

rows.source_ko: 7. Matters concerning policy communication with the media, such as meetings and briefings
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning policy communication with the media, such as meetings and briefings

rows.source_ko: 8. Monitoring, analysis, and response to media and online activities related to policy issues
rows.text_en: 8. Monitoring, analysis, and response to media and online activities related to policy issues

rows.source_ko: 9. Matters concerning policy promotion through media outlets, such as interviews, contributions, and appearances
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning policy promotion through media outlets, such as interviews, contributions, and appearances

rows.source_ko: 10. Management of media coverage performance regarding major policies and management of policy communication evaluation
rows.text_en: 10. Management of media coverage performance regarding major policies and management of policy communication evaluation

rows.source_ko: 11. Other matters concerning support and cooperation for domestic and foreign media coverage
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters concerning support and cooperation for domestic and foreign media coverage

rows.source_ko: ④ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 20, 2022>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. Establishment, coordination, consultation, and support of digital communication plans regarding major policies
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, consultation, and support of digital communication plans regarding major policies

rows.source_ko: 2. Production and management of digital communication content for the public regarding major policies
rows.text_en: 2. Production and management of digital communication content for the public regarding major policies

rows.source_ko: 3. Management of various information and situations related to policy promotion
rows.text_en: 3. Management of various information and situations related to policy promotion

rows.source_ko: 4. Overall management, monitoring, and evaluation of social media policy communication, including the designation and operation of online spokespersons
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management, monitoring, and evaluation of social media policy communication, including the designation and operation of online spokespersons

rows.source_ko: 5. Cooperation in policy promotion with relevant agencies and organizations
rows.text_en: 5. Cooperation in policy promotion with relevant agencies and organizations

rows.source_ko: 6. Matters concerning public relations training to enhance public relations expertise
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning public relations training to enhance public relations expertise

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Ministerial Policy Advisors) One of the Ministerial Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, with the job grade of that position being Grade B, and the other shall be appointed as a special-category public official equivalent to Grade 3 or Grade 4. However, in the event of special circumstances, a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service may be replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and a special-category public official equivalent to Grade 3 or Grade 4 may be replaced by a general-category public official of Grade 4 or higher; and in the case of appointment as a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of that position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Ministerial Policy Advisors) One of the Ministerial Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, with the job grade of that position being Grade B, and the other shall be appointed as a special-category public official equivalent to Grade 3 or Grade 4. However, in the event of special circumstances, a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service may be replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and a special-category public official equivalent to Grade 3 or Grade 4 may be replaced by a general-category public official of Grade 4 or higher; and in the case of appointment as a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of that position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: [Wholly Amended Dec. 26, 2017]
rows.text_en: [Wholly Amended Dec. 26, 2017]

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② One Audit Officer shall be appointed under the Auditor, and the Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, or Industrial Research Officers. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
rows.text_en: ② One Audit Officer shall be appointed under the Auditor, and the Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, Secretaries, or Industrial Research Officers. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters.
rows.text_en: ③ The Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. Audit of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its affiliated organizations
rows.text_en: 1. Audit of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its affiliated organizations

rows.source_ko: 2. Audit of affiliated organizations (including affiliated public institutions and associations/organizations; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)
rows.text_en: 2. Audit of affiliated organizations (including affiliated public institutions and associations/organizations; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 3. Handling of audit results by other agencies regarding the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its affiliated and subordinate organizations
rows.text_en: 3. Handling of audit results by other agencies regarding the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its affiliated and subordinate organizations

rows.source_ko: 4. Operation of the Code of Conduct for Public Officials pursuant to the Anti-Corruption Act
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of the Code of Conduct for Public Officials pursuant to the Anti-Corruption Act

rows.source_ko: 5. Matters concerning the registration and examination of assets of affiliated public officials pursuant to the Public Officials Ethics Act
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the registration and examination of assets of affiliated public officials pursuant to the Public Officials Ethics Act

rows.source_ko: 6. Matters concerning the prohibition of improper solicitation pursuant to the Act on the Prohibition of Improper Solicitation and Acceptance of Bribes, etc.
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the prohibition of improper solicitation pursuant to the Act on the Prohibition of Improper Solicitation and Acceptance of Bribes, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. Investigation and handling of complaints and misconduct
rows.text_en: 7. Investigation and handling of complaints and misconduct

rows.source_ko: 8. Matters concerning the military service reporting of affiliated public officials pursuant to the Act on the Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Matters of Public Officials, etc.
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the military service reporting of affiliated public officials pursuant to the Act on the Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Matters of Public Officials, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 감사에 관한 통계의 유지 및 비위사항에 대한 요인의 분석
rows.text_en: 9. Maintenance of audit statistics and analysis of factors regarding misconduct

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 장관이 감사에 관하여 지시한 사항의 처리
rows.text_en: 10. Handling of other matters instructed by the Minister regarding audits

rows.source_ko: 제6조(기획조정실장) ① 기획조정실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 7. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Director of Planning and Coordination Office) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended July 21, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제9조제1항에 따라 기획조정실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 정책기획관으로 하며, 정책기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <신설 2020. 7. 21., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory body placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination shall be the Director of Policy Planning; the Director of Policy Planning shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Newly added July 21, 2020; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책기획관은 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제9조제3항 각 호의 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 7. 21., 2021. 12. 14., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Policy Planning assists the Director General of Planning and Coordination with respect to the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Jul. 21, 2020; Dec. 14, 2021; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 기획조정실장 밑에 기획총괄담당관, 재정운용담당관, 혁신행정담당관, 규제개혁법무담당관, 정보화담당관, 비상재난담당관 각 1명을 두며, 기획총괄담당관, 재정운용담당관, 혁신행정담당관, 규제개혁법무담당관 및 정보화담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로, 비상재난담당관은 임기제 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 12. 20., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 2. 25., 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ④ Under the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office, there shall be one Director General for Planning and Coordination, Director General for Financial Management, Director General for Innovation and Administration, Director General for Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs, Director General for Informatization, and Director General for Emergency and Disaster Management; the Director General for Planning and Coordination, Director General for Financial Management, Director General for Innovation and Administration, Director General for Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs, and Director General for Informatization shall be appointed as Deputy Director Generals, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Research Officer for Industrial Technology, while the Director General for Emergency and Disaster Management shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary under a fixed-term contract. <Amended Dec. 20, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025; Jun. 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기획총괄담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General of Planning and Coordination assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended June 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 각종 정책과 계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation, synthesis, overall management, and coordination of various policies and plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요 정책 현안과제 및 미래전략의 발굴ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Identification and coordination of major policy issues and future strategies

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 업무계획의 지침 수립ㆍ종합ㆍ조정 및 정책 메시지 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment, synthesis, and coordination of guidelines for major work plans, and management of policy messages

rows.source_ko: 4. 중소벤처기업부 연간 업무계획 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and overall management of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups' annual work plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 대통령 및 국무총리 지시사항의 종합ㆍ조정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Consolidation, coordination, and management of directives by the President and the Prime Minister

rows.source_ko: 6. 대통령, 국무총리, 경제부총리 등이 주재하는 대외 회의체의 대응
rows.text_en: 6. Response to external meetings presided over by the President, Prime Minister, Deputy Prime Minister for Economy, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 재정경제부, 산업통상부 등 부처 간 정책협의기구 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of inter-ministerial policy consultative bodies, including the Ministry of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

rows.source_ko: 8. 국무회의 및 차관회의 토론 과제 발굴ㆍ검토 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management of the identification and review of discussion topics for Cabinet and Vice-Ministerial meetings

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 담당관의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officers within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 재정운용담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Officer in Charge of Financial Management assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Newly added June 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국회 및 정당 등과의 정책 협조
rows.text_en: 1. Policy cooperation with the National Assembly and political parties, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산의 편성 및 기금(중소벤처기업창업 및 진흥기금과 소상공인시장진흥기금에 한정한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 운용계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Formulation of the budget and establishment and adjustment of operation plans for funds (limited to the Fund for Startup and Promotion of Small and Medium Enterprises and Ventures and the Fund for the Promotion of Small Business Markets; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 3. 예산 및 기금의 집행ㆍ결산에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the execution and settlement of budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 4. 중기재정운용계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Coordination of Medium-term Fiscal Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산 및 기금 등 재정사업의 성과관리 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Performance Management and Evaluation of Financial Projects, Including Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 6. 총사업비 관리 및 예비타당성 조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the management of total project costs and preliminary feasibility studies

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 혁신행정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25., 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Innovation Administration Officer assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025; Jun. 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 조직의 진단 및 평가를 통한 조직과 정원의 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Management of organization and staffing through organizational diagnosis and evaluation

rows.source_ko: 2. 사무분장규정 및 위임전결규정의 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Regulations on Division of Duties and Regulations on Delegation of Authority

rows.source_ko: 3. 본부와 지방중소벤처기업청 간의 업무 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Coordination of duties between Headquarters and Regional SME and Venture Business Administrations

rows.source_ko: 4. 지방중소벤처기업청에 대한 평가 및 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the evaluation and management of regional SME and Venture Business Administrations

rows.source_ko: 5. 부 내 정부위원회 관련 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of affairs related to government committees within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 6. 소관 공공기관의 정책평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the policy evaluation of relevant public institutions

rows.source_ko: 7. 소관 공공기관ㆍ단체 관리 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of public institutions and organizations under its jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 8. 업무처리절차의 분석 및 개선, 조직문화의 혁신 등 부 내 창의혁신업무의 총괄ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management and support of creative innovation activities within the department, including analysis and improvement of work procedures and innovation of organizational culture.

rows.source_ko: 9. 중소기업 관련 행정제도 개선계획의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and execution of plans to improve administrative systems related to small and medium-sized enterprises

rows.source_ko: 10. 성과관리업무 및 국정과제 평가의 총괄ㆍ조정 및 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management, coordination, and support of performance management tasks and evaluation of national policy tasks

rows.source_ko: 11. 정부업무평가(기관평가를 포함한다) 관련 기본계획의 수립 및 추진
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and implementation of basic plans related to government performance evaluation (including agency evaluation)

rows.source_ko: 12. 자체평가계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 자체평가위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment and Implementation of Self-Evaluation Plan and Operation of the Self-Evaluation Committee

rows.source_ko: 13. 부 내 정부혁신 관련 과제 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 확인ㆍ점검 및 성과관리
rows.text_en: 13. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks within the Ministry, verification and monitoring of implementation status, and performance management

rows.source_ko: 14. 직무성과계약제 운영ㆍ평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning the operation and evaluation of the job performance contract system
⑧ The Officer for Legal Affairs on Regulatory Reform shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Jan. 21, 2020; July 21, 2020; Dec. 20, 2022; Apr. 30, 2024; Jun. 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 행정기관이 요청하는 중소기업 규제영향분석서 검토 및 의견제시
rows.text_en: 1. Review of regulatory impact analyses for SMEs requested by administrative agencies and provision of opinions

rows.source_ko: 2. 중소기업 규제영향평가 자문위원의 구성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Composition and Operation of the Advisory Committee for Regulatory Impact Assessment of SMEs

rows.source_ko: 3. 중소기업 관련 신설ㆍ강화 규제에 대한 홍보 및 의견수렴
rows.text_en: 3. Promotion of and collection of opinions on newly established and strengthened regulations related to SMEs

rows.source_ko: 4. 중소기업 규제영향분석 교육
rows.text_en: 4. Training on Regulatory Impact Analysis for SMEs

rows.source_ko: 5. 중소기업 규제 관련 조사ㆍ연구 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Survey, Research, and Evaluation Regarding Regulations on Small and Medium Enterprises

rows.source_ko: 6. 외국의 중소기업 규제 관련 법령 및 제도의 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 6. Investigation and research on foreign laws and systems related to SME regulations

rows.source_ko: 7. 중소기업 규제 관련 정보시스템의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of information systems related to SME regulations

rows.source_ko: 8. 중소기업 소통마당 및 현장방문 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of SME Communication Forums and On-site Visits

rows.source_ko: 9. 중소기업 규제영향분석 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the Regulatory Impact Analysis System for SMEs

rows.text_en: Article 9 (SME Policy Office) ① The Director of the SME Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제1항에 따라 중소기업정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 중소기업정책관ㆍ글로벌성장정책관ㆍ기술혁신정책관 및 지역기업정책관으로 하며, 중소기업정책관ㆍ글로벌성장정책관ㆍ기술혁신정책관 및 지역기업정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2024. 4. 30., 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director-General for SME Policy shall be the Director-General for SME Policy, the Director-General for Global Growth Policy, the Director-General for Technology Innovation Policy, and the Director-General for Regional Enterprise Policy; these positions shall be filled by general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of these positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Apr. 30, 2024; Jun. 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(창업벤처혁신실) ① 창업벤처혁신실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Startup and Venture Innovation Office) ① The Head of the Startup and Venture Innovation Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제1항에 따라 창업벤처혁신실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 창업정책관 및 벤처정책관으로 하며, 창업정책관 및 벤처정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of Startup and Venture Innovation are the Director of Startup Policy and the Director of Venture Policy. The Director of Startup Policy and the Director of Venture Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the positions shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 창업정책관은 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제1호부터 제7호까지, 제7호의2, 제8호부터 제17호까지 및 제20호의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director-General for Startup Policy assists the Director-General with respect to matters under Article 13, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 1 through 7 , 7-2, 8 through 17, and 20 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies. ” <Amended Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 벤처정책관은 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제19호 및 제21호부터 제28호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director General for Venture Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 13, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 19 and 21 through 28 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 창업벤처혁신실에 창업정책과, 신산업기술창업과, 창업생태계과, 청년정책과, 글로벌창업팀, 벤처정책과, 벤처투자과, 투자관리감독과, 특구운영과 및 특구지원과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로, 팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Startup & Venture Innovation Office shall have the Startup Policy Division, New Industry Technology Startup Division, Startup Ecosystem Division, Youth Policy Division, Global Startup Team, Venture Policy Division, Venture Investment Division, Investment Management & Supervision Division, Special Zone Operations Division, and Special Zone Support Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer, and the heads of each team shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 청년정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 글로벌창업팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2024. 2. 27.>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(소상공인정책실) ① 소상공인정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Small Business Policy Office) ① The Head of the Small Business Policy Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제14조제1항에 따라 소상공인정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 소상공인정책관 및 소상공인경영안정지원관으로 하며, 소상공인정책관 및 소상공인경영안정지원관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director-General for Small Business Policy shall be the Director-General for Small Business Policy and the Director-General for Small Business Management Stabilization Support; the Director-General for Small Business Policy and the Director-General for Small Business Management Stabilization Support shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 소상공인정책관은 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제14조제3항제1호부터 제25호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2023. 2. 28., 2024. 12. 31., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Small Business Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 14, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 25 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended Feb. 28, 2023; Dec. 31, 2024; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 소상공인경영안정지원관은 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제14조제3항제26호부터 제31호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director General for Small Business Management Stabilization shall assist the Director General with respect to matters under Subparagraphs 26 through 31 of Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 소상공인정책실에 소상공인정책과, 소상공인성장촉진과, 지역상권과, 전통시장과, 소상공인경영안정정책과, 소상공인경영안정지원과, 소상공인재도약과 및 디지털소상공인과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 12. 31., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Small Business Policy Office shall have the Small Business Policy Division, Small Business Growth Promotion Division, Regional Commercial District Division, Traditional Market Division, Small Business Management Stabilization Policy Division, Small Business Management Stabilization Support Division, Small Business Re-launch Division, and Digital Small Business Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Research Officer for Industry. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 31, 2024; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제3장 지방중소벤처기업청
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Regional Small and Medium Business Administration

rows.source_ko: 제12조(관할구역) 지방중소벤처기업청의 관할구역은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Jurisdiction) The jurisdictional areas of the Regional Small and Medium Business Administration are as shown in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(지방중소벤처기업청) ① 1급지 지방중소벤처기업청장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 하고, 2급지 지방중소벤처기업청장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. 다만, 2급지 지방중소벤처기업청장 중 대전ㆍ세종지방중소벤처기업청장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2020. 3. 31., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Regional SME and Venture Business Administrations) ① The heads of Grade 1 regional SME and Venture Business Administrations shall be appointed from among general or research civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such positions is Grade B; and the heads of Grade 2 regional SME and Venture Business Administrations shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer. However, among the Grade 2 regional SME and Venture Business Administration heads, the head of the Daejeon-Sejong Regional SME and Venture Business Administration may be appointed as Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer, allocated and operated through mutual transfer pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Mar. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 1급지 지방중소벤처기업청에 지역정책과, 성장지원과, 창업벤처과 및 소상공인과를 두고, 2급지 지방중소벤처기업청에 지역정책과 및 지역혁신과를 두되, 각 과장은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 보한다. <개정 2019. 5. 21., 2020. 3. 31., 2022. 12. 20., 2023. 2. 28., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Regional Policy Division, Growth Support Division, Startup & Venture Division, and Small Business Division shall be established in Grade 1 Regional SME & Venture Business Administrations, and the Regional Policy Division and Regional Innovation Division shall be established in Grade 2 Regional SME & Venture Business Administrations; provided that the head of each division shall be appointed in accordance with the classifications in the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 21, 2019; March 31, 2020; December 20, 2022; February 28, 2023; August 30, 2023; December 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 경기지방중소벤처기업청 지역정책과장: 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관
rows.text_en: 1. Head of Regional Policy Division, Gyeonggi Regional Office of SMEs and Startups: Deputy Director General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1호를 제외한 1급지 지방중소벤처기업청의 지역정책과장, 서울지방중소벤처기업청, 대구ㆍ경북지방중소벤처기업청, 광주ㆍ전남지방중소벤처기업청 및 경기지방중소벤처기업청의 성장지원과장: 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관. 다만, 서울지방중소벤처기업청, 대구ㆍ경북지방중소벤처기업청 및 광주ㆍ전남지방중소벤처기업청의 지역정책과장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제2항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: 2. Heads of Regional Policy Divisions of Grade 1 Regional Small and Medium Business Administrations excluding Item 1, and Heads of Growth Support Divisions of Seoul Regional Small and Medium Business Administration, Daegu-Gyeongbuk Regional Small and Medium Business Administration, Gwangju-Jeonnam Regional Small and Medium Business Administration, and Gyeonggi Regional Small and Medium Business Administration: Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Industrial Research Officer. However, the Heads of Regional Policy Divisions of Seoul Regional Small and Medium Business Administration, Daegu-Gyeongbuk Regional Small and Medium Business Administration, and Gwangju-Jeonnam Regional Small and Medium Business Administration may be appointed as Deputy Directors, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or Senior Secretary who are assigned and operated through mutual transfer in accordance with Article 27, Paragraph 2 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies.

rows.source_ko: 3. 서울지방중소벤처기업청 창업벤처과장, 부산지방중소벤처기업청 성장지원과장 및 창업벤처과장: 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 공업연구관
rows.text_en: 3. Head of Startup & Venture Division, Seoul Regional Office of SMEs and Startups; Head of Growth Support Division and Head of Startup & Venture Division, Busan Regional Office of SMEs and Startups: Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer

rows.source_ko: 4. 2급지 지방중소벤처기업청의 지역정책과장: 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 공업연구관. 다만, 각 과장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제2항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: 4. Head of Regional Policy Division of a Grade 2 Regional Small and Medium Business Administration: Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. However, each division head may be appointed from among the Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Administrative Officer assigned and operated through mutual transfer in accordance with Article 27 , Paragraph 2 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies.

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖의 지방중소벤처기업청의 각 과장: 공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 공업연구관. 다만, 각 과장(강원지방중소벤처기업청, 전북지방중소벤처기업청 및 경남지방중소벤처기업청의 지역혁신과장은 제외한다)은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제2항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: 5. Each division head of other regional SMEs and Startups agencies: Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. However, each division head (excluding the Regional Innovation Division Heads of the Gangwon Regional SMEs and Startups Agency, Jeonbuk Regional SMEs and Startups Agency, and Gyeongnam Regional SMEs and Startups Agency) may be appointed from among the Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, or Administrative Officer assigned and operated through mutual transfer in accordance with Article 27, Paragraph 2 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies.

rows.source_ko: ③ 사무소장은 제13조제3항부터 제6항(제5항제29호부터 제34호까지는 제외한다)까지의 업무를 분장한다. <개정 2019. 5. 21., 2023. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the office shall be responsible for the duties set forth in Article 13, paragraphs 3 through 6 (excluding subparagraphs 29 through 34 of paragraph 5). <Amended May 21, 2019; Feb. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ④ 사무소장은 지방중소벤처기업청장의 명을 받아 소관 사무를 총괄하고, 소속공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The head of the office shall oversee affairs under his/her jurisdiction and direct and supervise officials under his/her jurisdiction upon receiving orders from the head of the Regional Small and Medium Business Administration.

rows.source_ko: 제4장 공무원의 정원
rows.text_en: Chapter 4. Number of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제15조(중소벤처기업부에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 중소벤처기업부에 두는 공무원의 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제26조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 3에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 아니하는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 정원은 별표 4와 같다. <개정 2017. 12. 26., 2018. 3. 30., 2020. 7. 21., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Ministry of SMEs and Startups) ① The personnel quota for public officials in the Ministry of SMEs and Startups (excluding temporary quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies ; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) is as set forth in Annex 3. However,pursuant to the proviso to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its Affiliated Agencies, within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total quota set forth in Annex 3 , is as set forth in Annex 4. <Amended Dec. 26, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018; July 21, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 중소벤처기업부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 2명(4급 또는 5급 1명, 6급 1명) 및 그 밖의 정원 중 3명(4급 3명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 3. 30., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, two persons responsible for public relations (one at Grade 4 or 5, and one at Grade 6) and three persons from the remaining authorized number (three at Grade 4) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Mar. 30, 2018; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 중소벤처기업부에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 디지털 홍보 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2019. 2. 28., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, one person (Grade 5) responsible for public data-related duties and one person (Grade 5) responsible for digital promotion duties shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Feb. 28, 2019; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 지방중소벤처기업청 및 사무소에 두는 공무원의 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 5와 같다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제27조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 5에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 아니하는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 정원은 별표 5의2와 같다. <개정 2017. 12. 26., 2018. 3. 30., 2020. 7. 21., 2020. 12. 23., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The personnel quota for public officials in regional SMEs and Startups agencies and offices (excluding temporary quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” ; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) shall be as set forth in Table 5. However, the personnel quota for public officials determined separately, within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota set forth in Table 5 pursuant to Article 29 , Paragraph 2 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and the proviso to Article 27 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its Affiliated Agencies,” shall be as set forth in Table 5-2 . <Amended Dec. 26, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018; July 21, 2020; Dec. 23, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 구미전자공업고등학교ㆍ부산기계공업고등학교 및 전북기계공업고등학교에 두는 공무원의 정원은 별표 6과 같다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「중소벤처기업부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제27조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 6에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 아니하는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 정원은 별표 6의2와 같다. <개정 2017. 12. 26., 2018. 3. 30., 2020. 7. 21., 2020. 12. 23., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials assigned to Gumi Electronic Engineering High School, Busan Mechanical Engineering High School, and Jeonbuk Mechanical Engineering High School is as set forth in Attached Table 6. However, the authorized number of public officials separately determined within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total authorized number set forth in Attached Table 6, pursuant to Article 29 , Paragraph 2 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Authorities of Administrative Agencies” and the proviso to Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Agencies,” is as set forth in Attached Table 6-2 . <Amended Dec. 26, 2017; Mar. 30, 2018; July 21, 2020; Dec. 23, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 지방중소벤처기업청 및 사무소에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 2명(4급 2명), 구미전자공업고등학교ㆍ부산기계공업고등학교 및 전북기계공업고등학교에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 3명(교장 3명)은 임기제 공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Two positions (two Grade 4) out of the authorized quota for public officials at Regional Small and Medium Business Administrations and their offices, and three positions (three principals) out of the authorized quota for public officials at Gumi Electronic Engineering High School, Busan Mechanical Engineering High School, and Jeonbuk Mechanical Engineering High School may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Aug. 30, 2023>
Article 17 Deleted <Aug. 30, 2023>
Chapter 5 Deleted <March 24, 2026>
Article 18 Deleted <Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제6장 한시조직 및 한시정원 <개정 2019. 5. 21.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 6 Organizations and Quotas for Temporary Officials <Amended May 21, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(특구혁신기획단장) ① 특구혁신기획단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Head of Special Zone Innovation Planning Team) ① The Head of the Special Zone Innovation Planning Team shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 특구혁신기획단장에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 8과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The number of public officials by rank assigned to the Head of the Special Zone Innovation Planning Group is as shown in Table 8 .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 20, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의2(특구정책과) ① 중소벤처기업부 창업벤처혁신실에 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제17조의3에 따라 2026년 12월 31일까지 존속하는 한시조직으로 특구정책과를 둔다. <개정 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-2 (Special Zone Policy Division) ① A Special Zone Policy Division shall be established within the Startup & Venture Innovation Office of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups as a temporary organization to exist until December 31, 2026, in accordance with Article 17-3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies . <Amended Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 특구정책과에 과장 1명을 두며, 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Special Zone Policy Division shall have one Division Head, who shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Research Officer for Industry. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 특구정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Special Zone Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 특구 정책 및 제도의 총괄 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Overall operation of special zone policies and systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 규제자유특구 관련 정책 및 제도의 입안ㆍ기획
rows.text_en: 2. Drafting and planning of policies and systems related to Special Regulatory Free Zones

rows.source_ko: 3. 규제자유특구에 관한 법령의 운용
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of laws and regulations concerning Special Regulatory Free Zones

rows.source_ko: 4. 규제자유특구 관련 지방자치단체의 혁신사업 또는 전략산업 육성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning innovation projects or the promotion of strategic industries by local governments related to Special Regulation-Free Zones

rows.source_ko: 5. 규제자유특구 운영의 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Evaluation of the Operation of Special Regulatory-Free Zones

rows.source_ko: 6. 규제자유특구와 관련되는 지원기관의 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 6. Management and Supervision of Support Agencies Related to Regulatory-Free Zones

rows.source_ko: 7. 규제자유특구 관련 정보망의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and operation of information networks related to Special Regulatory-Free Zones

rows.source_ko: 8. 글로벌 혁신특구 관련 정책 및 제도의 입안ㆍ기획
rows.text_en: 8. Drafting and planning of policies and systems related to Global Innovation Zones

rows.source_ko: 9. 글로벌 혁신특구에 관한 법령의 운용
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of laws and regulations concerning Global Innovation Zones

rows.source_ko: 10. 글로벌 혁신특구 운영의 평가
rows.text_en: 10. Evaluation of Global Innovation Zone Operations

rows.source_ko: 11. 글로벌 혁신특구와 관련되는 지원기관의 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 11. Management and Supervision of Support Organizations Related to Global Innovation Zones

rows.source_ko: 12. 글로벌 혁신특구 관련 정보망의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment and operation of an information network related to Global Innovation Zones

rows.source_ko: 13. 지역특화발전특구 관련 정책 및 제도의 입안ㆍ기획
rows.text_en: 13. Drafting and planning of policies and systems related to Regional Specialized Development Zones

rows.source_ko: 14. 지역특화발전특구에 관한 법령의 운용
rows.text_en: 14. Operation of laws and regulations concerning Specialized Regional Development Zones

rows.source_ko: 15. 지역특화발전특구 운영의 평가
rows.text_en: 15. Evaluation of the Operation of Regional Specialized Development Zones

rows.source_ko: 16. 지역특화발전특구와 관련되는 지원기관의 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 16. Management and Supervision of Support Agencies Related to Regional Specialized Development Zones

rows.source_ko: 17. 특구 관련 예산 및 결산의 총괄 운영
rows.text_en: 17. Overall management of budgets and settlements related to the Special Zone

rows.source_ko: 18. 특구 관련 성과 홍보, 대외 협력 및 국제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Matters concerning promotion of achievements related to the Special Zone, external cooperation, and international cooperation

rows.source_ko: 19. 특구 제도 운영 관련 부처 등 협의체 운영
rows.text_en: 19. Operation of a consultative body including ministries related to the operation of the Special Zone system

rows.source_ko: ④ 특구정책과에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 8과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The authorized number of public officials by rank in the Special Zone Policy Division is as shown in Attached Table 8 .

[This Article was newly added on Dec. 20, 2022.]
[Formerly Article 19-2 was moved to Article 19-3 <Dec. 20, 2022>]
Article 19-3 Deleted <December 31, 2024>
Article 19-4 Deleted <October 1, 2025>
Article 19-5 Deleted <October 1, 2025>
Article 19-6 Deleted <October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(한시정원) ① 소상공인 손실보상 업무를 추진하기 위하여 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따라 2026년 12월 31일까지 별표 9에 따른 한시정원을 중소벤처기업부에 둔다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Temporary Staffing) ① In order to carry out the work of compensating losses for small business owners, a temporary staffing quota set forth in Annex 9 shall be established within the Ministry of SMEs and Startupsuntil December 31, 2026, pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 소상공인 손실보상 업무를 추진하기 위하여 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따라 2026년 12월 31일까지 별표 9에 따른 한시정원을 지방중소벤처기업청에 둔다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② In order to carry out tasks related to compensation for losses incurred by small business owners, temporary personnel quotas set forth in Annex 9 shall be established at the Regional Small and Medium Business Administrations until December 31, 2026, pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <중소벤처기업부령 제1호, 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of SMEs and Startups Decree No. 1, July 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 폐지) 중소기업청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙을 폐지한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Repeal of Other Laws)  The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Small and Medium Business Administration and its affiliated agencies are hereby repealed.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능 이관에 따른 공무원의 이체) ① 중견기업 정책 기능의 이관에 따라 이 규칙 시행 당시 중소기업청 소속 공무원 중 17명(고위공무원단 1명, 3급 또는 4급 1명, 4급 1명, 4급 또는 5급 1명, 5급 5명, 6급 5명, 7급 1명, 8급 2명)은 산업통상자원부 소속으로 보아 이를 산업통상자원부로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transfer of Public Officials Following Transfer of Functions)  ① In accordance with the transfer of policy functions for middle-sized enterprises, 17 public officials belonging to the Small and Medium Business Administration at the time of the enforcement of this rule (1 member of the Senior Civil Service, 1 person of Grade 3 or 4, 1 person of Grade 4, 1 person of Grade 4 or 5, 5 people of Grade 5, 5 people of Grade 6, 1 person of Grade 7, and 2 people of Grade 8) shall be deemed to belong to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and transferred to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy.

rows.source_ko: ② 기술창업활성화 관련 창조경제 진흥에 관한 사무의 이관에 따라 이 규칙 시행 당시 미래창조과학부 소속 공무원 50명(고위공무원단 1명, 4급 5명, 4급 또는 5급 4명, 5급 19명, 6급 17명, 7급 1명, 8급 2명, 관리운영 9급 1명)은 중소벤처기업부 소속 공무원으로 보아 이를 중소벤처기업부로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with the transfer of affairs regarding the promotion of the creative economy related to the activation of technology startups, 50 public officials belonging to the Ministry of Science, ICT and Future Planning at the time of the enforcement of this rule (1 senior civil servant, 5 Grade 4 officials, 4 Grade 4 or 5 officials, 19 Grade 5 officials, 17 Grade 6 officials, 1 Grade 7 official, 2 Grade 8 officials, and 1 Grade 9 official for management and operation) shall be deemed to be public officials belonging to the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and transferred to the Ministry of SMEs and Startups.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기업에 대한 산업인력의 공급ㆍ활용, 대ㆍ중소기업 간 협력 및 지역산업 지원 등에 관한 사무의 이관에 따라 이 규칙 시행 당시 산업통상자원부 소속 공무원 21명(4급 3명, 4급 또는 5급 2명, 5급 8명, 6급 7명, 8급 1명)은 중소벤처기업부 소속 공무원으로 보아 이를 중소벤처기업부로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In accordance with the transfer of affairs regarding the supply and utilization of industrial manpower to enterprises, cooperation between large and small and medium-sized enterprises, and support for regional industries, 21 public officials belonging to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy at the time of the enforcement of this rule (3 officials of Grade 4, 2 officials of Grade 4 or 5, 8 officials of Grade 5, 7 officials of Grade 6, and 1 official of Grade 8) shall be deemed to be public officials belonging to the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and shall be transferred to the Ministry of SMEs and Startups.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 13, Paragraph 6, Subparagraph 12-3 shall enter into force on July 4, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 4의 정원 12명(행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 공업연구관 8명, 행정주사ㆍ세무주사ㆍ통계주사ㆍ사서주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사 또는 공업연구사 2명, 행정주사보ㆍ세무주사보ㆍ통계주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보ㆍ방송통신주사보 또는 공업연구사 1명, 운전서기 1명)은 2028년 6월 8일까지 존속하며, 2028년 6월 9일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 4의 행정주사ㆍ세무주사ㆍ통계주사ㆍ사서주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사 또는 공업연구사 8명, 행정주사보ㆍ세무주사보ㆍ통계주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보ㆍ방송통신주사보 또는 공업연구사 2명, 행정서기ㆍ세무서기ㆍ통계서기ㆍ공업서기ㆍ전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 1명, 운전서기보 1명으로 본다. <개정 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The 12 authorized positions specified in Annex 4 whose job grades are upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule (8 Administrative Officers, Statistics Officers, Industrial Officers, Medical Technology Officers, Food Hygiene Officers, Environmental Officers, Facilities Officers, Computer Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Industrial Research Officers; 2 Administrative Assistants, Tax Assistants, Statistics Assistants, Librarian Assistants, Industrial Assistants, Facilities Assistants, Computer Assistants, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistants, or Industrial Researchers; 1 Assistant Administrative Assistant, Tax Assistant, Statistics Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Facilities Assistant, Computer Assistant, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant, or Industrial Researcher; and 1 Driver Clerk) shall remain in effect until June 8, 2028, and thereafter, the corresponding authorized positions shall be as specified in Annex 4 Eight administrative clerks, tax clerks, statistical clerks, librarian clerks, industrial clerks, facility clerks, computer clerks, broadcasting and telecommunications clerks, or industrial researchers; two assistant administrative clerks, assistant tax clerks, assistant statistical clerks, assistant industrial clerks, assistant facility clerks, assistant computer clerks, assistant broadcasting and telecommunications clerks, or industrial researchers; one administrative clerk, tax clerk, statistical clerk, industrial clerk, computer clerk, or broadcasting and telecommunications clerk; and one assistant driver clerk. <Amended June 8, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 5의2의 정원 3명(행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 공업연구관 3명)은 2028년 6월 8일까지 존속하며, 2028년 6월 9일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 5의2의 행정주사ㆍ세무주사ㆍ통계주사ㆍ사서주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사 또는 공업연구사 3명으로 본다. <개정 2026. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ② The three authorized positions specified in Annex 5-2 (three Administrative Officers, Statistical Officers, Industrial Officers, Medical Technology Officers, Food Hygiene Officers, Environmental Officers, Facilities Officers, Computer Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Industrial Research Officers) whose ranks are upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in effect until June 8, 2028; thereafter, the corresponding authorized positions shall be deemed to be three Administrative Assistants, Tax Assistants, Statistical Assistants, Librarian Assistants, Industrial Assistants, Facilities Assistants, Computer Assistants, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistants, or Industrial Researchers specified in Annex 5-2. <Amended June 8, 2026>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its Affiliated Agencies is amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제10조제12항제1호, 제2호 및 제11호 중 “중소기업창업투자회사”를 각각 “벤처투자회사”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 10, Paragraph 12, Subparagraphs 1, 2, and 11, “Small and Medium Enterprise Startup Investment Company” shall be changed to “Venture Investment Company”.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 글로벌창업팀은 2027년 2월 26일까지 존속한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① Global Startup Teams newly established under the enforcement of this rule pursuant to Article 29 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” shall exist until February 26, 2027.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 4의 정원 3명(행정사무관ㆍ통계사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 공업연구관 3명)은 2028년 6월 8일까지 존속하며, 2028년 6월 9일 이후에는 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 4의 정원 3명(행정주사ㆍ세무주사ㆍ통계주사ㆍ사서주사ㆍ공업주사ㆍ시설주사ㆍ전산주사ㆍ방송통신주사 또는 공업연구사 3명)으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The three positions specified in Annex 4 whose job grades are upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule (three Administrative Officers, Statistics Officers, Industrial Officers, Medical Technology Officers, Food Hygiene Officers, Environmental Officers, Facilities Officers, Computer Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Industrial Research Officers) shall remain in effect until June 8, 2028, and thereafter, the corresponding positions shall be deemed to be the three positions specified in Annex 4 (three Administrative Assistants, Tax Assistants, Statistics Assistants, Librarian Assistants, Industrial Assistants, Facilities Assistants, Computer Assistants, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistants, or Industrial Researchers).
